M-BEHAVIOR-REGISTRY.Purpose: Reference and subscription tracking for behavior owners: ref-count behavior targets and keep a per-owner ledger of event subscriptions for bulk release.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: BehaviorRegistry: Increment/Decrement ref counting on behavior targets.

Requirements.REQ-001: Decrement to zero triggers target release exactly once.
Requirements.REQ-002: UnregisterSubscriptions(owner) releases every handler the owner registered, in registration order.
Requirements.REQ-003: Bind/Watch store strong event handlers until property replacement or explicit owner cleanup; registration identity distinguishes Bind/Watch and event kind.
Requirements.REQ-004: ConditionalWeakTable tracks subscription records per owner but does not weaken publisher event handlers; Widget Unmount and FVP ReleaseFvp provide deterministic owner cleanup.
Requirements.REQ-005: Re-registering the same (owner, key, handler) releases its previous registration before replacement.

Inputs.IN-001: target: object — behavior target being ref-counted.

Outputs.OUT-001: bool from Decrement — whether the target was released.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Invokes release actions when subscriptions are unregistered.

M-BEHAVIOR-REGISTRY.Codemap: * `BehaviorRegistry.Decrement(target)` => refcount == 0 => release * `BehaviorRegistry.RegisterSubscription(owner, key, handler, release)` * `BehaviorRegistry.UnregisterSubscription(owner, key, handler)` * `BehaviorRegistry.UnregisterSubscriptions(owner)` => release(owner.handlers) * `BehaviorRegistry` <= `BindRef` + `WatchRef` + `WidgetTree`
